source: SciELO Rev Saude Publica - Cholera Epidemiology Mozambique 1973-1992
processing_notes: Source states: '1973: 753 cases, 90 deaths' - interpreted as 753 sCh cases and 90 deaths. First epidemic year in Mozambique following introduction via Beira seaport. source: SciELO Rev Saude Publica - Cholera Epidemiology Mozambique 1973-1992
processing_notes: Source states: '1975-1977: 29 cases total, 6 deaths (sporadic cases)' - interpreted as 29 sCh cases and 6 deaths over three years 1975-1977. Sporadic pattern after initial epidemic. source: SciELO Rev Saude Publica - Cholera Epidemiology Mozambique 1973-1992
processing_notes: Source indicates sporadic pattern 1975-1977 and resumed activity 1979. Year 1978 not mentioned in annual data. Evidence type: Surveillance_Gap - formal data collection system not yet fully operational. Confidence 0.6.
